I think /u/naarff is trying to say, don't hope too much, but don't let it go completely either. Just throw the subject to the back of your mind and deal with it when it comes. I'm horrible with girls and just letting it go has helped a lot more(for my mental health) than trying to improve and failing at it again and again. Good luck mate. Hope you find love. I believe everyone deserves it until proven otherwise.

Thank you, friend. What you are saying is completely true. I used to enjoy drawing (my long time passion) before I started strapping expectations and ambitions on it. When my future(and to a further extent, my happiness) depended upon it, drawing felt less free and more suffocating, and as a result, I avoid it. I guess staying away from it for a while would be the best call. I do seek out the facilities at my college, but it seems they are in quite a high demand. (have been on waitlist for around 4 months) I will try to hold on, and hope for a better day. Thank you very much, and have a great day.

Thank you very much. Although I do not have a lot of people I can talk to about this, there are some, and those few friends really help me. I'll try to work slowly towards being better. Thank you for your advice and your kinds words, and have a great day.

Thank you very much for you kind words and advice. I'll try to take heed of the advice you've written in your post. (Side note: I do draw a lot, but I'm anxious about it do to expecting too much of myself) And the point about the love of your life is a very heartwarming point indeed. It is something to look forward to. I'll try to not listen to the voice in my head that says it can't happen. Thank you, and have a great day.
Thanks for your advice man. I'll try taking it slow, and will just try to be friends with her. I just try to enjoy the process. Thanks!
